Population.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/8] Hanging or ligaturing accounted for two thirds (40, 67%) of the near-lethal attempts. There were also 12 (20%) incidents of severe cutting, three (5%) self-asphyxiations, three (5%) overdoses of paracetamol and/or ibuprofen, one (2%) ingestion of foreign objects (plastic knives) and one (2%) self-immolation. Six prisoners used multiple methods in their suicide attempts; three both hung and cut themselves, one prisoner cut himself and took an overdose of 40 anti-depressant tablets, one took an overdose of 40 ibuprofen tablets and swallowed 30 razorblades and one hung himself and also put a plastic bag over his head.
